# Employee Benefits Policy

## Health Insurance

The company offers medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on the
first day of the month following an employee's start date. The company
covers 80% of the premium for employee-only coverage and 60% for dependents.
Three medical plan tiers are available (HMO, PPO, and high-deductible with
HSA) so employees can choose based on their needs.

## Retirement Plan

Employees are eligible to enroll in the 401(k) plan immediately upon hire.
The company matches 100% of contributions up to 4% of base salary, and
matching contributions vest immediately. Enrollment and contribution changes
can be made at any time through the benefits portal.

## Life and Disability Insurance

Basic life insurance (1x annual salary) and short-term disability coverage
are provided to all full-time employees at no cost. Supplemental life
insurance and long-term disability coverage are available for purchase at
group rates during open enrollment.

## Wellness and Other Perks

Employees receive a $50 monthly wellness stipend that can be used for gym
memberships, fitness classes, or mental health apps. An Employee Assistance
Program (EAP) offering free confidential counseling sessions is available to
all employees and their household members at any time.

## Open Enrollment

Benefit elections can be changed once a year during the open enrollment
period in November, or within 30 days of a qualifying life event such as
marriage, birth of a child, or loss of other coverage.
